text:
sam: Heads-up — PR #17682 is ready but cross-region integ is flaking on eu-west-2. We have a deploy freeze starting Mon 2025-08-04 18:00 UTC and want to avoid getting stuck in the queue. CI link: https://ci.internal/build/9843. Can we coordinate a short plan (rebase -> canary -> full merge) or do a lane-switch to land in us-first and stagger eu?
maria: Can you paste the flaky step/job id and the specific failure? If it's a transient infra timeout we might rerun instead of blocking the whole merge.
sam: Job is 9843. Fails in step `replicate-network` with a connection timeout ~2m consistently on eu-west-2 runners. Repro locally with: `./scripts/run-integ --region eu-west-2` (hangs). I don't want to skip eu tests; propose: 1) rebase, 2) rerun cross-region, 3) if passes, canary on dedicated capacity (10% traffic) then full. If it still flakes, land us-first canary and monitor, then backfill eu when infra stabilizes. Thoughts?
ryan: If we do us-first canary we should add a short rollback window and smoke checks. @oncall can you monitor the canary for 30–60m after merge?
oncall: I can watch it. Post-merge, I need the quick rollback command and the smoke test script to run. Prefer rollback command in PR description (e.g., `./scripts/rollback pr-17682`).
maria: Rebase to main and ping CI to rerun the eu job. Also add the canary/rollback plan into the PR description so reviewers can +1 with that context. @ci-bot can you rerun job 9843?
ci-bot: Re-run requested by @maria. Queued job 9844 for cross-region integ.
sam: Thanks. If 9844 passes on eu, can someone give a merge +1? I'll add the canary notes to the PR now. @ryan @maria
ryan: I'll +1 if the eu job is green and PR includes rollback + smoke steps.
maria: +1 after green.
ci-bot: Job 9844 completed — eu-west-2 failed again (timeout). Queued re-run 9845.
sam: Ok, still flaky. Ops said there's a higher error rate on the eu runners this morning. Two options: 1) hold until infra fix (risky with freeze), 2) land us-first canary with explicit exclusion for eu region and backfill later. I prefer (2) with a short SLA to backfill eu within 24h. Agree?
ryan: Agree with (2) if oncall can watch and rollback is ready. Add a note in the release notes that eu was delayed due to infra flake.
oncall: I'll be on stand-by for 1hr after merge. If we see errors on canary, I'll trigger `./scripts/rollback pr-17682` and alert infra.
maria: OK. Please add the backfill ticket in the PR (`BACKFILL-289`) and tag infra. Then I can give final +1.
sam: Done — PR description updated with canary steps, rollback command, and BACKFILL-289. Rebase also pushed. @ci-bot please run a final smoke matrix (jobs 9846/9847).
ci-bot: Smoke matrix queued. jobs 9846 (us-east-1) passed, 9847 (eu-west-2) still flaky and queued.
ryan: That's enough for my +1 — we have the plan and oncall. +1 from me.
maria: +1 as well. Land when you're ready, sam. Please post merge time and monitoring channel. :thumbsup:
sam: Merging in ~10m to hit low-traffic window. Will post in #incidents-monitoring and tag @oncall. Thanks all.
